scope: 全病理类型报告研究；风险训练队列为全部记录复发者和DFS>12个月未复发者，共19,540例。仅对有分层验证支持的病理类型及时间点提供研究估计，不代表所有手术患者的已校准绝对风险。
scope_en: All histologies in report analysis; risk cohort includes all recorded recurrences and nonrecurrences with DFS >12 months (n=19,540). Estimates require histology/horizon validation support and are not calibrated absolute risks for all surgical patients.
time_origin: 手术日起算；预测至术后1、3、5年
time_origin_en: From surgery to postoperative years 1, 3 and 5
validation_summary: 患者级外五折、内三折；1/3/5年记录复发净风险。单中心回顾性研究；选择队列与死亡资料局限仍在。个体部位排序按病理分层启用。
validation_summary_en: Patient-level outer fivefold / inner threefold validation of recorded-recurrence net risk. Retrospective single-centre selected cohort; incomplete competing-death ascertainment. Individual site ranking enabled only in supported histology strata.

site_model.interpretation: Exploratory ranking of any recorded recurrence sites among observed recurrences; not adjudicated first-event sites or organ-specific absolute risks.

importance.metric: Held-out three-year IPCW Brier increase after field permutation
